items.title: Govt repurchases Tk 1,716cr T-bonds in first-ever buyback auction
items.description: The government has bought back Tk 1,716 crore worth of two-year treasury bonds before their maturity in the country’s first-ever government bond buyback auction, opening a new way for it to manage when and how its debt is repaid.

items.title: AkijBashir joins RE100, pledges 100% renewable power by 2050
items.description: AkijBashir Group has become the first Bangladeshi company to join RE100, a global corporate renewable energy initiative, committing to use 100 percent renewable electricity across its operations by 2050.

items.title: Govt secures $3.1b loan to keep fuel and LNG flowing
items.description: Bangladesh has secured a $3.1 billion non-concessional loan to finance fuel oil and liquefied natural gas imports, as the government moves to safeguard energy supplies from disruption.

items.title: National Bank depositors to get full access to funds from October 15
items.description: Customers of National Bank PLC will be able to avail themselves of all banking services, including withdrawing money, from October 15, 2026, as per their requirements, from all branches and ATM booths across the country.
